# Cinema 4D Python SDK 2027.0.0

> Python API of Maxon Cinema 4D: the `c4d` (Cinema API), `maxon` (Maxon API), and `mxutils` packages, with manuals, constant tables, and runnable examples. This repository holds the official SDK download with its HTML documentation converted to Markdown in `docs_md/`.

How to use this repository:

- Look up any class, method, function, constant (`c4d.COPYFLAGS_NO_HIERARCHY`), type id (`c4d.Osphere`), description resource (`Osphere`), or description parameter (`PRIM_SPHERE_RAD`) by name in [docs_md/symbols.tsv](docs_md/symbols.tsv). Columns: name, role, path#anchor relative to the SDK root, title. Grep it, it is too large to read whole.
- Markdown pages mirror the online documentation paths; `<a id="..."></a>` tags keep the original Sphinx anchors, so `#c4d.BaseObject.GetMg` style fragments resolve.
- Description parameter ids of objects, tags, and materials are in [.agents/descriptions](.agents/descriptions/_overview.md); node space ports are in [.agents/nodespaces](.agents/nodespaces/_overview.md).
- Example source code lives in [examples/](examples/); coding rules for agents are in [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md).

## Indexes

- [Documentation index](docs_md/INDEX.md): all sections with page counts
- [Documentation start page](docs_md/index.md)
- [What's new](docs_md/indexes/whatisnew.md): changes in this release
- [Symbol table](docs_md/symbols.tsv): API symbols, constants, type ids, and description parameters mapped to their files

## Manuals

- [Manuals](docs_md/manuals/index.md): Browse guides for Cinema 4D Python scripting and plugin development.
- [API Overview](docs_md/manuals/manual_api_overview.md): Provides an overview of the major API components.
- [Assets](docs_md/manuals/manual_assets.md): Provide content as reusable assets served with the Cinema 4D Asset Browser.
- [Debugging](docs_md/manuals/manual_debugging.md): Explains how to find errors in Python code for Cinema 4D with the mxutils debug tools, and how to track down crashes caused by threading violations.
- [External Libraries](docs_md/manuals/manual_external_libraries.md): Explains how to expose third-party libraries to Cinema 4D Python.
- [Geometry Model](docs_md/manuals/manual_geometry.md): Explains the geometry model of Cinema 4D: polygons, edges, normals, caches, and splines.
- [Graph Descriptions](docs_md/manuals/manual_graph_descriptions.md): Explains how to generate node materials with graph descriptions.
- [Implementing Plugins](docs_md/manuals/manual_implementing_plugins.md): Explains the basic concepts of implementing plugins.
- [Input Events](docs_md/manuals/manual_input_events.md): Input events are messages about input from the keyboard or from the mouse.
- [Licensing](docs_md/manuals/manual_licensing.md): Explains licensing for Python plugins in Cinema 4D.
- [Matrices](docs_md/manuals/manual_matrices.md): Explains how to carry out transform operations.
- [Message System](docs_md/manuals/manual_message_system.md): Explains messages between Cinema 4D scene elements and interfaces.
- [Python Environment](docs_md/manuals/manual_python_environment.md): Explains the features and limitations of Cinema 4D’s Python runtime.
- [Quickstart](docs_md/manuals/manual_quickstart.md): Learn the basics of using the Cinema 4D Python API.
- [Dialog and Description Resources](docs_md/manuals/manual_resource_files.md): Explains how to define dialogs and node parameters with resource files, and how to use them from Python.
- [Scene Execution](docs_md/manuals/manual_scene_execution.md): Explains how Cinema 4D updates a scene, and where Python code runs in that process.
- [Scene Structure](docs_md/manuals/manual_scene_structure.md): Explains how a Cinema 4D scene is organized with hierarchies and branches, and how to traverse it.
- [Script Manager and Console](docs_md/manuals/manual_script_manager.md): Write and run scripts in the Script Manager and inspect results in the Python Console.
- [Scripting Elements](docs_md/manuals/manual_scripting_elements.md): Explains Python scripting elements embedded in Cinema 4D scenes.
- [Standalone Interpreter](docs_md/manuals/manual_standalone_interpreter.md): Explains how to use Cinema 4D’s standalone interpreter, c4dpy.
- [Style Guide](docs_md/manuals/manual_style_guide.md): Explains the code style and conventions used in this SDK.
- [Symbol Parsing](docs_md/manuals/manual_symbol_parsing.md): Explains resource symbols and mxutils.ImportSymbols.
- [Vectors](docs_md/manuals/manual_vectors.md): Explains how to carry out vector operations.
- [Working with the SDK](docs_md/manuals/manual_working_with_sdk.md): Set up Visual Studio Code to work with the Cinema 4D Python SDK.

## API Reference

- [c4d.bitmaps](docs_md/modules/c4d.bitmaps/index.md): Classes: MultipassBitmap, BaseBitmap, ColorProfile, ColorProfileConvert, GeClipMap, MovieLoader, MovieSaver
- [c4d.documents](docs_md/modules/c4d.documents/index.md): Classes: BaseDocument, BaseVideoPost, BatchRender, LayerObject, RenderData
- [c4d.gui](docs_md/modules/c4d.gui/index.md): Classes: BitmapButtonCustomGui, DateTimeControl, DescriptionCustomGui, FontChooserCustomGui, GradientCustomGui, HtmlViewerCustomGui, HyperLinkCustomGui, InExcludeCustomGui, LinkBoxGui, QuickTabCustomGui, RangeCustomGui, SoundEffectorCustomGui, SplineCustomGui, TreeViewCustomGui, BaseCustomGui, C4DGadget, …
- [c4d.modules](docs_md/modules/c4d.modules/index.md): Classes: PaintLayerBmp, PaintLayerFolder, PaintLayerMask, PaintLayer, PaintMaterial, PaintTexture, PaintBitmap, TempUVHandle, bodypaint, CAJointObject, CAMorph, CAMorphNode, CAPoseMorphTag, CAReferencePSD, CAWeightMgr, CAWeightTag, …
- [c4d.plugins](docs_md/modules/c4d.plugins/index.md): Provides classes to implement and functions to register plugins.
- [c4d.storage](docs_md/modules/c4d.storage/index.md): Classes: HyperFile, MemoryFileStruct
- [c4d.threading](docs_md/modules/c4d.threading/index.md): Classes: BaseThread, C4DThread
- [c4d.utils](docs_md/modules/c4d.utils/index.md): Classes: ConvexHullDecomposition, GeRayCollider, KDTree, KDTreeQuery, Neighbor, PolygonReduction, SplineHelp, SplineLengthData, ViewportSelect, C4DNoise, noise
- [c4d](docs_md/modules/c4d/index.md): An overview of not all but important types in the c4d module.
- [Cinema API](docs_md/modules/cinema_api.md)
- [Maxon API](docs_md/modules/maxon/maxon_api.md)
- [mxutils API](docs_md/modules/mxutils_api.md): Contains helper functions and types that are written in Python and exclusive to the Python API.

- [Type Indexes](docs_md/index/types.md): Object, tag, shader, material, track, and field type ids.
- [Constants](docs_md/index/consts.md): Enumerations and symbol groups such as `COPYFLAGS` or `DIRTYFLAGS`.
- [Examples](docs_md/index/examples.md): Annotated example scripts and plugins of the SDK.
- [Other Indexes](docs_md/index/indexes.md): What's new, example index, type index, resource index.
